body:
C1 ENTRY AUDIT — CURRENT MAIN 07d1aa94, READ-ONLY

I rechecked the source rather than relying on the plan. The architecture gap remains exactly where the staged plan says it is.

PRESENT AND REUSABLE

- core/atlas.scala has checked StorySource and SurfaceAtlas with exact UTF-16 text navigation.
- core/transcript.scala has TranscriptAtlas plus optional AudioSpan.
- features has typed scalar/vector/distribution tracks, reducers, coverage, windows, and target traversal.
- acquire has provider-neutral task/proposal/critic/resolution records.
- document has a pure deterministic NarrativeCompiler and durable NarrativeCompilation.
- story/align/view already carry the shared narrative graph, hierarchy, recall alignment, and renderer-neutral projection machinery.

NOT PRESENT IN ANY SCALA SOURCE

- SourceBundle
- PresentationAxis
- EvidenceSupport
- NarrativeSourceAtlas
- MediaAtlas
- media/shot/frame/entity-track/audio-interval FeatureTarget cases

THE EXACT TEXT-BOUND SEAMS

1. core/claim.scala: Evidence carries Option[SpanSet], and SurfaceExplicit is licensed by span evidence.
2. document/compiler.scala: NarrativeCompilerInput requires StorySource plus SurfaceAtlas; charts are keyed by SurfaceUnitId; every support and receipt is checked against canonical text.
3. story/alignment.scala: AlignmentSource.sourceSupport returns Option[SpanSet].
4. align/source.scala: NodeSummary.support is SpanSet and SourceView normalizes positions by textLength.
5. features/space.scala and track.scala: SupportResolver and FeatureObservation support are text SpanSet based.
6. StoryModel still owns StorySource plus SurfaceAtlas directly.

LEGACY TIMED-TRANSCRIPT COURT

AudioSpan is nonnegative integral milliseconds, admits the explicit empty interval start=end, and has no native stream/timebase/epoch/rendition identity. TranscriptTurn.audio is Option[AudioSpan]. TranscriptAtlas requires adjacent present audio starts to agree with text order, and turnAtAudio returns the first matching turn. Those are valid text/interview-overlay semantics; they are insufficient for overlapping cinematic speech, signed/native PTS, gaps, multiple matches, or clock-refusal provenance.

Therefore C1 must not rename or reinterpret AudioSpan as a movie coordinate. It must introduce separate portable media types and an explicit checked binding when a legacy timed transcript is associated with a source axis. The C1 conformance fixture must preserve absent, nonempty, and explicit-empty AudioSpan behavior byte-for-byte and prove that none silently becomes a media EvidenceSupport anchor.

STAGE BOUNDARY CONFIRMED

- C1: new provider-free cross-platform source/axis/coordinate/interval-set/evidence/atlas contracts, smart constructors, refusal laws, plus text and legacy timed-transcript conformance adapters.
- D0: first admitted Sherlock read into the C1 substrate.
- D1: broad migration of ClaimMeta/Evidence, NarrativeCompilerInput, FeatureTarget/support, StoryModel envelope, AlignmentSource/SourceView, codecs, and view seams.
- Workers, learned features, speaker identity, audiovisual proposals, and StoryAtlas film UI remain later stages.

This audit does not open C1: P1 and aggregate B0 still must close, and no file, package, decoder, source read, dependency, or API migration is authorized. Team: AMEND only if one named seam belongs to a different stage or if a current source path contradicts this measured boundary.
